category.name: Web search
category.description: Search engines and answer APIs that return fresh web results, snippets or full page content in agent-friendly formats.

entries.name: Brave Search API
entries.free_tier: $5 free monthly credits (~1,000 queries on Search plan); credit card required at signup as anti-fraud measure
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent query Brave's independent web/image/video/news search index and get cited, LLM-ready results.
entries.notes: Official MCP server (@brave/brave-search-mcp-server) is self-hosted only via npx/Docker/HTTP transport, no vendor-hosted remote endpoint found; Answers plan is separate ($4/1,000 req + token costs).

entries.name: Exa
entries.free_tier: free tier: $10 free credits/month (~1,400 searches), no payment method required
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent run neural or keyword web search, retrieve page contents, and find similar links via Exa's API.
entries.notes: Remote MCP endpoint requires no API key to start; self-hosted npm package (exa-mcp-server) also available.

entries.name: Jina AI Search / Reader
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <JINA_API_KEY> (works without a key too, but at a lower rate limit)
entries.free_tier: no key needed: 100 RPM (s.jina.ai search) / 500 RPM (r.jina.ai reader); free API key raises limits to 1,000/5,000 RPM with token-based billing
entries.desc_en: Search the web or convert any URL into clean LLM-ready markdown via simple HTTP GET requests.
entries.notes: Usable without an API key at reduced rate limits; interactive docs/playground at https://api.jina.ai/scalar. No official MCP server found.

entries.name: Kagi Search API
entries.free_tier: no free tier: pay-per-use, $12 per 1,000 search requests, invoiced monthly or at $100 usage, whichever first
entries.desc_en: Run programmatic, ad-free premium web/news/image/video searches and extract page markdown via a paid REST API.
entries.notes: Requires a funded/billed Kagi account; on Family/Team plans only the account owner can access the API portal. Official hosted MCP endpoint also available at https://mcp.kagi.com/mcp using just an API key.

entries.name: Linkup
entries.free_tier: $20 free credits/month for new accounts signing up with a professional email
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent search, fetch pages, or run deep multi-source research via Linkup's Search/Fetch/Research API endpoints.
entries.notes: Also supports the x402 protocol: pay-per-request in USDC on Base with no account required; Extract endpoint is in closed beta; MCP endpoint also supports ?apiKey= query param auth.

entries.name: Mojeek Search API
entries.auth_hint: check docs (exact query-param name obtained after contacting Mojeek for a plan)
entries.free_tier: limited-query free trial available on request; paid plans from £2 CPM (Startup, 5 req/s, 100k/day cap)
entries.desc_en: Query Mojeek's independent web index for titles, URLs and snippets in JSON or XML, with country/language boosting.
entries.notes: Sign-up is not instant self-serve, requires contacting Mojeek via their contact form to get a key/plan (Startup/Business/Enterprise). Independent (non-Google/Bing-derived) index.

entries.name: Parallel Web Systems Search API
entries.free_tier: free: 5,000 requests/month across APIs, plus up to $80 signup credit and $5/month free credits
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent run Parallel's low-latency Search API for web research, content extraction, and entity discovery.
entries.notes: The remote MCP server is free and requires no account/API key; the main REST API requires an API key from the dashboard.

entries.name: Perplexity Sonar / Search API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <PERPLEXITY_API_KEY> (remote MCP also supports OAuth sign-in)
entries.free_tier: no confirmed free tier; pay-as-you-go, Search API billed at $5 per 1,000 requests
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent call Perplexity's Search API or MCP tools (search/ask/research/reason) for real-time grounded web answers.
entries.notes: Sonar Chat Completions endpoint is being migrated to the new Agent API with a migration deadline around 2026-09-27; platform now exposes four APIs: Search, Router, Agent, Embeddings.

entries.name: SearchApi.io
entries.auth_hint: api_key=<KEY> as query param, or Authorization: Bearer <KEY>
entries.free_tier: 100 free requests, no credit card required; then paid plans from $40/mo (10,000 searches)
entries.desc_en: Fetch structured JSON results from Google, Bing, YouTube, Amazon, TikTok and 50+ other search engines via one REST API.
entries.notes: Separate OpenAPI spec per engine (e.g. /openapi/google.yaml); no official MCP server found.

entries.name: SearXNG (self-hosted JSON API)
entries.auth_hint: none by default; self-hosted instance owner controls access (can add auth/proxy in front)
entries.free_tier: free, no key (self-hosted; you run and pay for the instance yourself)
entries.desc_en: Query a self-hosted SearXNG metasearch instance's JSON API to aggregate results from many search engines at once.
entries.notes: Not a vendor with a signup/API key, it's open-source software you self-host (or point at a trusted public instance from searx.space). JSON/CSV/RSS output formats must be explicitly enabled by the instance admin in settings.yml (search.formats); most public instances disable JSON and return 403. Included because it gives agents a genuine no-signup programmatic search interface once deployed.

entries.name: SerpApi
entries.auth_hint: api_key query parameter (also usable as header depending on client library)
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent scrape structured JSON results from Google and 20+ other search engines via SerpApi's REST API.
entries.notes: Cached searches are free and don't count toward the monthly search quota.

entries.name: Serper
entries.auth_hint: X-API-KEY header (per widely published examples; could not independently re-confirm via automated fetch, see notes)
entries.free_tier: free tier: 2,500 queries, no credit card required
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent fetch fast, low-cost Google search results (web, images, news, maps, shopping) via Serper's REST API.
entries.notes: serper.dev's docs/playground is a JS-rendered, login-gated SPA so automated fetch could not fully re-verify all details beyond the public marketing page (2,500 free queries confirmed there). No official MCP server found; listed repo is the most-starred community one.

entries.name: Tavily
entries.free_tier: free tier: 1,000 API credits/month, no credit card required
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent call Tavily's search API or MCP server to run web searches and get AI-ready summarized results.
entries.notes: Advanced search depth costs 2 credits vs 1 for basic/fast; remote MCP server supports both API key and OAuth authentication; repo: github.com/tavily-ai/tavily-mcp.

entries.name: You.com API
entries.free_tier: free credits on signup via you.com/platform; free search profile also available through the keyless Docs MCP server
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent call You.com's Search/Answer/Research API or MCP server for LLM-ready web search and grounded answers.
entries.notes: Current endpoint is POST https://ydc-index.io/v1/search (recommended); legacy GET still works but won't get new features; also offers a separate keyless Docs MCP server at you.com/docs/_mcp/server for searching You.com's own docs.
